name: Substack TV Reader
description: Clean newsletter reading on Substack with dark mode for TV

params.css: body { background: #0d1117 !important; color: #c9d1d9 !important; } [class*='paywall'], [class*='subscribe-widget'], [class*='subscription-widget'], [class*='footer-wrap'], .modal-overlay { display: none !important; } .body p, .post-content p { font-size: 22px !important; line-height: 1.8 !important; color: #c9d1d9 !important; overflow: visible !important; max-height: none !important; } h1 { font-size: 34px !important; color: #58a6ff !important; line-height: 1.3 !important; } h2 { color: #a47cff !important; } body, html { overflow: auto !important; position: static !important; }
